item.title: God's Holiday Travel Plans
item.description: God, according to His divine plans and purposes, orchestrated Joseph and Mary's seemingly bad road trip down to the minutest detail.

item.title: The Grace and Class of Erika Kirk
item.description: She embodies compassion, courage, kindness, faithfulness, forgiveness, and real godliness — the kind of character our world desperately needs.

item.title: Profiles of Valor: MSG Wiedorfer — A Christmas Day Medal of Honor
item.description: "Something had to be done, and someone had to do it. ... Luckily, their firing wasn't too good that day. They didn't get me."

item.title: Parenting Adult Children Can Be Heartbreaking
item.description: Parents, particularly moms, on the receiving end of "no contact" from their adult children have had it. But the only solution that will lead to reconciliation is God's grace.

item.title: Incentivized Entitlement Fraud
item.description: Minnesota's massive and growing welfare fraud scandal demonstrates the reality that the entitlement state has gotten too big and unaccountable.

item.title: Ford EVs Found on Road Dead
item.description: The auto giant has decided to cut its (huge) losses on electric vehicles after the Trump administration cut regulations and Congress dumped subsidies.

item.title: RFK Throws Down the Gauntlet on Gender Mutilation
item.description: Leftists claim they want to "protect trans kids," but that's a grossly misleading slogan. HHS is now actually doing it.

item.title: Friday Executive News Summary
item.description: A Brown University update, another illegal alien murder case, immigrant entitlement fraud in Massachusetts, New York launching state-sponsored suicide, and more.

item.title: Trump Repositions Pot
item.description: The president's executive order seeks to reclassify marijuana as less dangerous while at the same time ramping up our efforts toward medical research.
